'''Written Balosar''' was the written form of the [[Balosur|Balosar]] [[Language/Legends|language]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balosar/Legends|Balosar]]. The language was crude in appearance but equally complex to written [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]].<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />
